svg.title: Handover: architecture
svg.text: talks to Ari in the voice interview.
Browser. Reads the overview and map,
asks questions in the grounded chat.
Gemini CLI, Claude Code or Cursor,
connected to the knowledge base over
Docs, Sheets and Slides exported as text
OAuth 2.0 consent · read-only scopes · token per leaver
project gen-lang-client-0288239915 · region asia-southeast1 · deployed with one command: ./deploy.sh
service “handover” · one container · 1 instance, CPU always on
Python 3 · FastAPI · React/Vite UI built into the image · background sync keeps running after the request returns
every call is tied to something the user sees · structured output, validated into typed records
One call per document or event.
Pipeline order: sync → 1 → 2 → 3 → questions to the leaver → 4 → 5 → knowledge base complete → 6 and MCP serve the successor
Ari's voice: every narration and question
Authenticated as the service account handover-app (roles/aiplatform.user).
No Gemini API key exists in the deployed app.
native mode, asia-southeast1 · one workspace per leaver
documents · text, Drive link, content hash
Every merged fact traces back to a quote here
knowledge · one record per thing, typed links
gaps · questions, status, the leaver's answers
leaver · profile, OAuth token, sync state
Rebuilt from the evidence layer on every sync; only documents whose content changed are re-extracted.
read at start as the service account.
the new revision. No secrets in the public
Solid arrows: at run time. Dashed: at deploy time or by consent. Public repo, synthetic data, nothing confidential.
Beyond the prototype: more source readers (Slack, Gmail, Jira) · Vertex AI Vector Search when a handover outgrows one context · IAP in front of Ben's view and /mcp
